name: What improvements offer the best return on investment when selling a home?

mainEntity.name: What improvements offer the best return on investment when selling a home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Prioritizing strategic updates can significantly boost your home's appeal and value. Kitchen and bathroom renovations often yield high returns, as do minor cosmetic updates like fresh paint, updated light fixtures, and enhanced curb appeal. Consider a pre-listing consultation with a real estate professional from Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution to identify which specific improvements will be most impactful in your local Miami-Dade, Broward, Palm Beach, Collier, or Orange County market, as preferences can vary by area and neighborhood.
acceptedAnswer.description: Strategic updates to kitchens, bathrooms, paint, and curb appeal often offer the best return on investment when selling a home. Consult a local real estate professional to tailor recommendations to your market.
